complete_examples.text: Equation 5 computes the Area Under Curve (upper A upper U upper C), which is the area under the PR curve for a specific IoU and p left parenthesis r right parenthesis is the precision function.

Evaluation can also be conducted at specific IOU thresholds (Eq. 7), frequently reported as AP50 and AP75 for IOU values of 50% and 75% respectively [34], where upper A upper P stands for Average Precision, which is unique for each class given an IoU, n is the number of classes, and m is the number of IoU thresholds.
